business_question: How do consumers perceive traditional vs industrial fish sauce, and do associations/attitudes differ by region (Bắc/Trung/Nam) and user segment (Truyền thống/Công nghiệp)?

objectives.description: Describe word-association profiles and explicit/implicit attitudes by group.
Compare perception of the traditional vs industrial product type.
Characterize differences by region and user segment.
Link the word-association block to the attitude (IAT + explicit) block.

data_collection.sampling: Convenience sample of fish-sauce users; quotas by region/user type; not nationally representative.
known_limitations: Word association is free elicitation coded to word/element/topic (closest enum: free_comment)
IAT d_score sign convention requires the block-design doc to interpret valence
Region 'Không rõ'/'Unknown' present; gender has a casing typo ('Nam' vs 'nam')
Reaction-time columns use Vietnamese number format and need parsing
